title: MNEE launches on the 1Sat Ordinals protocol
description: MNEE announced the official launch of its USD-backed stablecoin on 1Sat Ordinals, with instant settlement and fees under one cent.
notes: The launch event records the verified 1Sat launch date. Ethereum availability and exact deployment identities are recorded separately without inferring an Ethereum launch date.

title: Bison Bank launches the EUB euro electronic-money token
description: Bison Bank announced the launch of EUB for pre-approved institutional partners as a euro-referenced electronic-money token using an approved-wallet Solana Token-2022 deployment.
notes: The canonical launch date follows the official 2026-05-06 public launch article. The whitepaper's 2026-04-10 offer start date is retained as context and not substituted for the first verified public launch statement or an unknown first on-chain mint date.

title: IZAKA-YA-affiliated guide publishes the JPYR Ethereum contract
description: An IZAKA-YA-affiliated MetaMask guide identified JPYR as an Ethereum token and published contract address 0xAf5D2cf39F2d4E2F5900D6cf37ab3596866347e4. This event records public deployment documentation, not the unknown original token launch date.
notes: Do not substitute this documentation date for first mint, first circulation, or launch. Explorer evidence corroborates the contract identity but not reserve backing or redemption rights.

title: JPYR-linked IZAKA-YA ecosystem lost its CryptoPanda wallet integration route
description: CryptoPanda announced termination of its partnership with IZAKA-YA and disabled transactions through IZAKA-YA wallet connections. The change followed IZAKA-YA's 2026-08-24 disclosure of temporary transfer and withdrawal restrictions for some accounts and affected a previously documented route used in JPYR-linked campaigns and transactions.
notes: This is an ecosystem access/off-ramp deterioration event. It does not establish that JPYR itself depegged, that its reserves became impaired, that a direct issuer redemption channel failed, or that all IZAKA-YA withdrawals were blocked. IZAKA-YA stated on 2026-08-27 that there was no platform-wide halt and that individually reviewed transfers were being processed.
